Book Title: It's OK to be Different: A Children's Picture Book About Diversity and Kindness
Author: Sharon Purtill, Sujata Saha
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Biographies > Multicultural
Summary: Literary Titan Gold Award Winning Book Every Child is Unique! Whether they are big or small, short or tall, like to swim, dance, sing or bike. Perhaps they have a special need or disability, or have a different ethnic background. Maybe they wear glasses, talk differently or require a wheelchair to get around. The truth is that all children are different and their individuality should be celebrated, not shunned. And this inspiring and brightly illustrated rhyming picture book does just that. By highlighting the ways kids are different from one another it helps children to accept themselves and others as the beautifully unique individuals that they are.  It's OK to be Different   encourages kids to be kind and befriend those who are different from themselves, showing young children that they don't have to look alike or enjoy doing the same activities to be kind to one another. Readers will come away with the message:  "You should always be kind to those who are different from you. Because to them, YOU are different too." As more children read this book and learn this concept, we can impact the world in a positive way while at the same time teach early literacy. This non-fiction book closes with a short survey for children about kindness and is a terrific way to help you start an age appropriate conversation about diversity. It's OK to be Different  is a kid's book that belongs in children's book libraries alongside other popular children's books like Goodnight Moon by Margaret Wise Brown because of the simplicity of the rhymes, the detailed illustrations and its uniquely powerful message about kindness and diversity. Themes represented in this book include diversity, kindness, anti-bullying, racism, disabilities and special needs. Author: Marta Almansa Esteva
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Growing Up & Facts of Life > Health > Diseases & Physical Illness
Summary: Join Nurse Bear in an educational and fun journey through basic first aid skills!  From burns to cuts and head bumps, Nurse Bear Does First Aid will show young readers what nurses do and how they can help too. Created by a children's nurse, this book features real-life tools and materials, making it easy for kids to recognize and become familiar with them. In Nurse Bear Does First Aid, children will learn essential first aid skills, such as calling an ambulance, checking vital signs, handwashing, and treating common injuries like cuts, burns, and head injuries. This delightful and informative book also covers how to handle asthma attacks and allergies. Ideal for children aged 2 to 6, Nurse Bear Does First Aid is an excellent teaching resource for families, home education / homeschooling, nurseries, childminders, school teachers, health visitors, school nurses, children's nurses, and other health professionals. Empower your child to be prepared and confident in an emergency with Nurse Bear as their guide! Discover the importance of first aid and how to respond to emergencies with Nurse Bear Does First Aid - the perfect addition to your child's learning journey!
